items.name: Paneer Tikka
items.description: Marinated cottage cheese cubes grilled in a tandoor with bell peppers, onions, and aromatic spices. Served with mint chutney.

ingredients.name: Paneer
ingredients.detail: Fresh cottage cheese marinated in yogurt and spices

ingredients.name: Bell Peppers
ingredients.detail: Colorful capsicum for crunch and sweetness

ingredients.name: Kashmiri Chilli
ingredients.detail: For vibrant color and mild heat

items.chefNote: Our paneer is made fresh in-house every morning. The tikka is marinated for 6 hours in a blend of 12 spices before being charred in our clay tandoor.

items.name: Chicken Tikka
items.description: Succulent boneless chicken pieces marinated in yogurt and spices, grilled to perfection in a clay tandoor.

ingredients.name: Ginger-Garlic
ingredients.detail: Fresh paste for depth of flavor

items.chefNote: We use only free-range chicken, marinated overnight in our secret 18-spice yogurt blend. The tandoor reaches 480°C for the perfect char.

items.name: Tandoori Chicken
items.description: Half chicken marinated in red tandoori masala and charcoal-grilled. The crown jewel of Indian grilled cuisine.

ingredients.name: Charcoal
ingredients.detail: Live coal smoking for smoky finish

items.chefNote: A timeless classic. Our tandoori chicken is double-marinated — first in lemon and salt, then in our signature yogurt-spice paste. Finished with a live coal smoke.

items.name: Hara Bhara Kebab
items.description: Vibrant green kebabs made with spinach, green peas, and potatoes. A vegetarian delight.
items.chefNote: These vibrant kebabs get their gorgeous green color from fresh spinach. We add a touch of cashew paste for creaminess.

items.name: Samosa
items.description: Crispy golden pastry triangles stuffed with spiced potatoes, peas, and cumin. Served with chutneys.

ingredients.name: Green Peas
ingredients.detail: Whole peas for bursts of sweetness

items.chefNote: Our samosas are hand-folded daily. The pastry is made with a touch of ajwain (carom seeds) for that authentic street-food crunch.

items.name: Dahi Ke Kebab
items.description: Melt-in-mouth kebabs made from hung yogurt, paneer, and aromatic spices, shallow fried to golden.
items.chefNote: These delicate kebabs are incredibly light — they literally melt on your tongue. The secret is triple-strained hung curd.

items.name: Malai Broccoli
items.description: Tender broccoli florets marinated in creamy cashew-cream paste, grilled until golden.
items.chefNote: A modern twist on the classic malai tikka. The broccoli stays perfectly crisp-tender inside the creamy coating.

items.name: Prawn Tikka
items.description: Jumbo tiger prawns marinated in ajwain and spices, grilled on skewers with lime.
items.chefNote: We source our tiger prawns daily from the coast. The ajwain marinade is a coastal Indian tradition that pairs beautifully with seafood.

items.name: Hyderabadi Chicken Biryani
items.description: Fragrant basmati rice layered with tender chicken, saffron, fried onions, and aromatic whole spices. Slow-cooked in the dum style.

ingredients.name: Basmati Rice
ingredients.detail: Aged long-grain rice, each grain separate

ingredients.name: Saffron
ingredients.detail: Kashmiri kesar, steeped in warm milk

ingredients.name: Whole Spices
ingredients.detail: Cardamom, cinnamon, star anise, bay leaf

items.chefNote: Our signature Hyderabadi biryani uses the authentic dum method — sealed with dough and slow-cooked for 45 minutes. The saffron-infused milk creates those beautiful golden streaks through the rice.

items.name: Mutton Biryani
items.description: Rich, aromatic biryani with tender slow-cooked mutton, layered with fragrant rice and caramelized onions.

ingredients.name: Saffron
ingredients.detail: Precious threads for color and aroma

items.chefNote: The mutton is marinated for 8 hours in raw papaya paste for tenderness, then slow-cooked until it falls off the bone.

items.name: Paneer Butter Masala
items.description: Soft paneer cubes simmered in a rich, velvety tomato-butter-cream gravy with aromatic spices.
items.chefNote: Our tomato gravy is slow-cooked for 4 hours until silky smooth. We finish with a generous swirl of cream and a sprinkle of kasuri methi.

items.name: Butter Chicken
items.description: Tender tandoori chicken pieces in a luscious tomato-butter-cream sauce. India's most beloved curry.
items.chefNote: Our butter chicken follows the original 1950s Moti Mahal recipe. The chicken is first grilled in the tandoor, then simmered in our signature makhani gravy made with 28 tomatoes per batch.

items.name: Dal Makhani
items.description: Black lentils and kidney beans slow-cooked overnight with butter, cream, and aromatic spices.
items.chefNote: This dal is started at midnight and simmered for 12 hours on a slow flame. The result is an impossibly creamy, smoky dal that is the soul of Punjabi cuisine.

items.name: Palak Paneer
items.description: Fresh spinach purée with soft paneer cubes, tempered with garlic and cumin.
items.chefNote: We blanch the spinach in ice water to preserve its vibrant green color. No food coloring — just pure, fresh palak.

items.name: Kadai Paneer
items.description: Paneer stir-fried with bell peppers, onions, and freshly ground kadai masala in a traditional iron wok.

ingredients.name: Kadai Masala
ingredients.detail: Freshly ground coriander and dried chilli

items.chefNote: The kadai masala is freshly pounded in our stone mortar for each batch. The iron kadai gives this dish its distinctive smoky flavor.

items.name: Chicken Tikka Masala
items.description: Tandoori chicken tikka pieces in a rich, creamy masala gravy with roasted spices.
items.chefNote: Our tikka masala uses freshly grilled chicken — never pre-cooked. The gravy is enriched with cashew paste for velvety smoothness.

items.name: Rogan Josh
items.description: Aromatic Kashmiri lamb curry with slow-braised meat in a rich yogurt and spice gravy.

ingredients.name: Kashmiri Chilli
ingredients.detail: For deep red color, mild heat

items.chefNote: An ancient Kashmiri recipe. The lamb is slow-braised for 3 hours until meltingly tender. We use Kashmiri chillies for color without excessive heat.

items.name: Vegetable Biryani
items.description: Fragrant dum-cooked basmati rice layered with seasonal vegetables, saffron, and aromatic herbs.
items.chefNote: Our vegetable biryani uses the same dum technique as our chicken version. Each vegetable is separately prepared to ensure perfect texture.

items.name: Masala Dosa
items.description: Crispy golden fermented rice-lentil crepe filled with spiced potato masala, served with sambar and coconut chutney.
items.chefNote: Our batter is fermented for 18 hours using a traditional stone-ground process. The result is an impossibly crisp, lacy dosa.

items.name: Naan Basket
items.description: Assortment of freshly baked tandoori breads — butter naan, garlic naan, and laccha paratha.
items.chefNote: Our naan is baked in a clay tandoor at 480°C. Each bread is hand-stretched and slapped onto the tandoor wall — the old-fashioned way.

items.name: Gulab Jamun
items.description: Soft, golden milk-solid dumplings soaked in warm rose-cardamom sugar syrup. Garnished with pistachios.
items.chefNote: Our gulab jamuns are made with fresh khoya, not milk powder. They're fried at a low temperature for an even golden color and soaked in saffron-rose syrup for 4 hours.

items.name: Rasmalai
items.description: Delicate saffron-cardamom milk patties floating in chilled, reduced sweetened milk.
items.chefNote: Each rasmalai patty is hand-shaped and cooked in sugar syrup until spongy, then transferred to our slowly reduced saffron milk.

items.name: Kulfi
items.description: Traditional Indian frozen dessert made with slow-reduced milk, flavored with cardamom, pistachio, and saffron.
items.chefNote: Real kulfi takes patience — we reduce milk for 3 hours until dense and creamy. No stabilizers, no artificial flavors. Just pure milk magic.

items.name: Gajar Ka Halwa
items.description: Grated carrots slow-cooked in milk with ghee, sugar, and topped with almonds and cashews.
items.chefNote: We use red Delhi carrots for the deepest color and sweetest flavor. Each batch is stirred by hand for 2 hours in a traditional kadai.

items.name: Jalebi
items.description: Crispy, spiral-shaped fermented batter swirls deep-fried and soaked in warm saffron sugar syrup.
items.chefNote: Our jalebi batter is fermented for 24 hours for that perfect tang. Each spiral is hand-piped into the oil and soaked in hot syrup for maximum crispiness.

items.name: Chocolate Lava Cake
items.description: Warm Belgian dark chocolate cake with a molten center, served with vanilla bean ice cream.
items.chefNote: Baked to order. The timing is everything — 12 minutes at exactly 200°C creates the perfect molten center surrounded by a just-set cake.

items.name: Kesar Pista Ice Cream
items.description: Rich saffron and pistachio ice cream made with real kesar and premium pistachios.
items.chefNote: Churned in small batches with real Kashmiri saffron and hand-chopped Iranian pistachios. No artificial colors or flavors.

items.name: Mango Lassi
items.description: Creamy yogurt smoothie blended with ripe Alphonso mangoes, cardamom, and a touch of saffron.
items.chefNote: We use only Ratnagiri Alphonso mangoes — the king of mangoes. Each lassi is blended to order with thick homemade curd.

items.name: Sweet Lassi
items.description: Traditional Punjabi sweet yogurt drink topped with a layer of malai and rose petals.
items.chefNote: Our lassi is churned in a traditional matka (clay pot) for that authentic Punjabi taste. Topped with fresh malai and dried rose petals.

items.name: Masala Chai
items.description: Aromatic Indian spiced tea brewed with ginger, cardamom, cinnamon, and cloves in whole milk.
items.chefNote: Our chai is brewed the way it's meant to be — simmered slowly with crushed spices and full-fat milk until rich and frothy. No tea bags, ever.

items.name: Filter Coffee
items.description: Traditional South Indian filter coffee — decoction brewed with a chicory blend, served frothy in a steel tumbler.
items.chefNote: Brewed using a traditional brass filter with beans from Chikmagalur. Served in a stainless steel tumbler and davara — the South Indian way.

items.name: Rose Milk
items.description: Chilled milk infused with rose syrup, topped with sabja seeds and crushed pistachios.
items.chefNote: A refreshing Mumbai street classic, elevated with our house-made rose syrup and premium pistachios.

items.name: Fresh Lime Soda
items.description: Freshly squeezed lime with soda water, black salt, and cumin. Sweet or salted — your choice.
items.chefNote: The perfect palate cleanser. We add a touch of roasted cumin and kala namak for that authentic Indian twist.

items.name: Lumière Signature Mocktail
items.description: Our house special — a layered blend of passion fruit, mango, pomegranate, and sparkling water with edible gold leaf.
items.chefNote: Our bartender's masterpiece. Each layer is carefully poured to create a stunning gradient of tropical flavors. The edible gold leaf adds that Lumière touch.
